english translation text: People of Shaam, do not torment us.

arabic text: KEHTA TAH MUHARI, GHURBAT PAY HUMARI, BUS KAAR\nNA RULAWO.
english translation text: From atop the camel he pleaded: ‘Have mercy upon\nour helplessness; do not make us weep any more.’

arabic text:
SAAR CHACHA KA MERAY IS WASTAY GIRR JAATA HAI
INKO BHENO KA KHULA SAAR JO NAZAR AATA HAI
GAYOOR KAY SAAR KO, LILLAAH NA LOGO,NAIZAY PAY
UTHAWO.
english translation text:
My uncle’s head falls for this very reason:
he sees the uncovered heads of his sisters.
For God’s sake, people, do not raise the
head of that honourable one upon a spear.

arabic text:
HAYE KYA KYA NA SITAM DHAAYE HAI HUM PAAR
TUMNAY
HADH YEH HAI CHEENLI TATHEER KI CHADAR TUMNAY
AB TUM WAHI CHADAR, NAIZE PAY UTHAKAR, HUMKO
NA DIKHAWO.
english translation text:
Alas, what cruelties have you not inflicted
upon us? You even snatched away the
cloak of Purity. Do not now
raise that very cloak upon a
spear and display it before us.

arabic text:
HUM ULIL-AMR HAI SHAYAD YEH NAHI TUMKO
KHABAR
HUM AGAAR CHAAHE TO BARSE ABHI TUM PAAR
PATTHAR
MAJBOOR SAMAJH KAAR, HAAYE TUM AALE NABHI PAR,
PATHAR NA GIRAWO.
english translation text:
We are the rightful holders of authority—perhaps
you do not know. Were we to
wish it, stones could rain upon
you at once. Do not mistake
us for helpless and cast stones
upon the family of the Prophet.

arabic text:
KAISE NAIZAY PAY UTHAAYA GAYA SAAR ASGHAR KA
KAISE PAAMAL KIYA IBNE-HASSAN KA LAASHA
YEH ZULM KAY KISSAY, MAT SAAMNE JAAKE, MAAWON
KO SUNAWO.
english translation text:
How was Asghar’s head raised upon a
spear? How was Hasan’s son trampled beneath
the horses? Do not go before
their mothers and recount these cruelties.

arabic text: SHAAM-E-ASHOOR SAY YE SOYI NAHI HAI AB TAK\nMAIN TO ROYA HOON YE ROYI BHI NAHI HAI AB TAK
english translation text: Since the evening of Ashura she has not slept. I have\nwept, but she has not even been able to cry.

arabic text: TUM MAAR LO MUJHKO, HAAYE PAR MERI PHUPHI KO,\nDURRAY NA LAGAWO.
english translation text: Strike me instead, but do\nnot lash my aunt.

arabic text:
RAASTE BHAR YEH TARAPTE RAHE PAANI KAY LIYE
TUMKO MALOOM NAHI KABSAY HAI PYAASAY BACHAY
BACHO KO DIKHA KAAR, IS TARHA ZAMEEN PAR, PAANI
NA BAHAWO.
english translation text:
Throughout the journey these children writhed for water.
You do not know how long they have
been thirsty. Do not show water to the
children and then spill it upon the ground.

arabic text:
AAJ BAT-TI HAI WAHAN NAAM PAY ZAINAB KAY RIDA
KAL TAKALLUM WAHAN BEMAAR MERA KEHTA RAHA
YEH ALAY NABHI HAI, HAYE TUM AISE NA INKO, BAY
PARDA PHIRAWO.
english translation text:
Today cloaks are distributed there in Zainab’s
name, while yesterday my ailing Imam kept
pleading: ‘These are the family of
the Prophet—do not parade them unveiled.’
